fields.FIR_Description: The reported incident took place on 2025-12-06 (night, 22:30): The complainant returned to the residence near Sindhu Garden Residential Colony in Erode and found the door forced open, with jewellery kept in a cupboard missing. Babu Selvam submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000442. The complainant alleged that Vignesh Subramani may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000487. Gokul Sundaram (9000000491), described as a business acquaintance, was also mentioned in the complaint. Items referenced in the complaint: physical documents and photographs. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00175, as the mobile number 9000000487 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Entry allegedly forced through a broken lock while the house was locked.
fields.Keywords: burglary, house break-in, documents, mobile number, associate, photograph, suspect, residential colony
